local function physicalForward(j)
 assert(j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint"),"MOTION_R15_ANIMATED_JOINT_REQUIRED:"..j.Name)
 local shoulder,limb
 if j:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
  assert(j.Attachment0 and j.Attachment1,"MOTION_R15_ATTACHMENTS_MISSING:"..j.Name)
  shoulder=j.Attachment0.WorldCFrame
  limb=shoulder*j.Transform*j.Attachment1.CFrame:Inverse()
 else
  assert(j.Part0 and j.Part1,"MOTION_R15_MOTOR_PARTS_MISSING:"..j.Name)
  shoulder=j.Part0.CFrame*j.C0
  limb=shoulder*j.Transform*j.C1:Inverse()
 end
 return (limb.Position-shoulder.Position):Dot(model:GetPivot().LookVector)
end

-- [종합 색 다양성] 동일 색상으로 뭉개지지 않은 181개 항구의 실제 변형값 검사 (화면 전수 검사는 아님).
local S=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('Shared') local P=require(S:WaitForChild('Ports')) local C=require(S:WaitForChild('PortCultures')) local I=require(S:WaitForChild('PortIdentity'))
local hashes={} for id in P.Ports do local s=assert(C.STYLE[C.REGION[id]]) local w,r=I.appearance(id,s.walls[1],s.roofs[1],s.street,Color3)
